source: 外研社(新标准)2019必修第一册 Unit 5 同主题完形(摄影师的一天/拯救金斑蝶/公园漫步/了不起的鹰/帮助小熊猫/动物的家)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: A Wildlife Photographer's Day
passages.text: Being a wildlife photographer is not an easy job. To get a good photo, I often have to (1)____ the elements, working outside in the wind and the rain. When a wild animal finally appears, I try to stay (4)____ so that I do not frighten it away. I must (5)____ on the animal and forget everything else around me. The hardest moment comes when I press the (6)____ at exactly the right time. One single (7)____ can show the beauty of a creature that most people will never (8)____ in the wild. After a long day, I am tired but happy. Each photo is a small (9)____ of a world that we should all learn to (10)____.
